paper_title: A Coin Has Two Sides A Novel Detector-Corrector Framework for Chinese   Spelling Correction
caption: Proportion of correct corrections among various error detection results in SIGHAN15. "P" signifies the errors in high precision results, "R" signifies in high recall results, "N" signifies not been detected. The suffix "W" indicates cases where correction has failed.
model_annotation: The chart depicts the proportion of correct corrections among various error detection results, with a total of seven slices representing different error categories. The categories are labeled “P” (light green), “PW” (darker green), “R” (yellow), “RW” (gold), “N” (light blue), and “NW” (dark blue). The “All Changes” pie chart shows “P” representing 14%, “PW” at 4%, “R” at 26%, “RW” at 5%, “N” at 1%, and “NW” at 50%, with the remaining portion unlabeled.  The “All Errors” pie chart displays “P” at 1%, “PW” at 6%, “R” at 29%, “RW” at 3%, “N” at 5%, and “NW” at 56%, with the remaining portion unlabeled. Percentage labels are displayed within each slice of both charts, and a legend is provided to identify the color associated with each category. The slices in each pie chart appear to be ordered from largest to smallest proportion.
